test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Gift of the gab
solution:
Here the correct answer is **A talent of speaking well.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom **"Gift of the gab"** is** option 4) A talent of speaking well. **
 
• The phrase **"Gift of the gab" **is often used to describe** someone who has a natural talent for speaking in a way that is persuasive, articulate, and engaging. **
 
• It implies that the person is able to hold people's attention, communicate effectively, and perhaps even charm them with their words.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
